description: Figure 6 (left) is a pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set,” which visualizes the proportional contribution of various datasets to the combined training corpus. The largest segment, colored blue, represents NQ (Natural Questions) at 31.3%. The second largest, in teal, is FEVER at 16.1%. SNLI accounts for 15.4% (orange), followed by MULTINLI at 11.3% (red). VITAMINC contributes 13.0% (light blue), while SCITAIL makes up 1.2% (green). Smaller slices include MULTIFC (0.5%, dark red), PUBHEALTH (0.5%, yellow-green), ANLI (4.6%, olive green), FACTCC (2.6%, dark orange), ENTFA (1.8%, dark teal), and SCIFACT (0.1%, very dark green). Each slice is labeled with its dataset name and percentage, and lines connect the labels to their corresponding segments. The chart shows a highly uneven distribution, with NQ, FEVER, SNLI, and MULTINLI together comprising over 70% of the training data.
